crossRefs.note: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome…
“Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh; “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two…
In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the…
“But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies…
Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it…
The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head…
Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from…
That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as…
As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not…
“It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children…
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

translations.web: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
translations.bsb: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
translations.kjv: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
